title: VA treatment program with flashing images and constant MRIs while benefits were denied
place_text: VA medical system, while working for BAE

tellings.quote: that this whole thing with these flashing images, MRIs constantly, all of it. And meanwhile, they're denying all of my VA benefits.

plain: Dylan Borland, a veteran who says he was then working for BAE, a large defence company, says that around 2017 the VA, the US department that cares for veterans, put him through treatment with flashing images and constant MRIs, a kind of brain and body scan. He says that at the same time the VA was denying all his veterans' benefits, and he points to his medical records. He tells it to suggest he was being studied while being refused help.
